profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer, AI Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience working cross functionally with sales, product, and design to deliver customer solutions from ideas to production. Proven track record of leading technical projects, evaluating architectural trade-offs, and driving clear decision-making to translate complex business requirements into scalable, accessible production solutions.


Technical Skills:
·       AI & LLM Systems: Pydantic-AI, Chroma, RAG, vector search, embeddings, Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, MCP servers, SSE streaming, prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot
·       Backend & Data: Node.js, Python, REST, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Webhooks, Kafka, Flink, S3
·       Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux, Storybook, Tailwind, Styled Components, WCAG 2.2, ARIA, axe-core
·       Infrastructure & Testing: GCP, Azure, Docker, GitHub Actions, Datadog, Temporal, LaunchDarkly, Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
- Led delivery and owned application architecture for Expertise on Demand, Syndios in-product RAG assistant, from hackathon prototype to production in under three months on a five-engineer team. 
- Owned the full request path as lead full-stack engineer: REST endpoints, SSE streaming, and a React/TypeScript chat UI rendering partial markdown with inline citations traced to source documents. 
- Scaled to 1000+ daily active users at 70% CSAT, cutting customer success manager workload 60%; grew usage another 20% by embedding the assistant in Slack. 
- Replaced a brittle homegrown workflow system with Temporal, rebuilding monolithic jobs as composable, fault-tolerant workflows and reducing on-call remediation time by 50% through step-level visibility. 
- Saved a $2M European contract weeks from termination by taking over unstaffed EU accessibility compliance, coordinating across teams to deliver the Accessibility Conformance Report a month ahead of deadline. 
- Accelerated team development workflows with an audit harness on axe-core and Playwright MCP with LLM-assisted remediation and shipped quality gates that cut regressions 30% and raised coverage 60%. 
- Mentored junior engineers through code reviews as well as conducted hiring interviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · REACT · Project Management · AI · Full-Stack Development · User Experience (UX) · UIX

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
·       Delivered end-to-end frontend and API integration work for a Web3 startup as an independent consultant, scoping requirements, building a responsive site, and shipping production-ready features autonomously across the full stack.
·       Integrated multi-chain wallet connection support and RPC node configuration across 3 additional blockchain networks, expanding platform accessibility and driving a 20% increase in users.
·       Cut load time by 40% through semantic HTML, server-side rendering (SSR), and optimized meta tags.
positions.insights: Skills: Strategic Planning · Project Coordination · Product Requirements · Ethereum · Cross-browser Compatibility · Next.js · TypeScript · Codebase Consolidation · JavaScript · CI/CD implementation · Technical Leadership · Operational Excellence · Application Frameworks · Performance Improvement · System Architecture · Vercel

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented GraphQL API endpoints for CPU usage charts, enabling real-time performance analysis across 300k internal VMs and contributing to over $50M in company savings. 
- Built internal telemetry and resource-visualization tooling used by hundreds of engineering teams across Azure infrastructure. 
- Consolidated three platform-specific frontend codebases (web, app, mobile) into a unified cross-surface architecture, eliminating 10k lines of redundant code and cutting maintenance overhead 66%. 
- Cut 30% of on-call tickets and accelerated feature release cycles by leading deployment of CI/CD practices. - Diagnosed and resolved live site incidents as an on-call engineer, triaging cross-functionally with teams across the organization.
positions.insights: Skills: REACT · Node.js · Microservices · Strategic Planning · REST APIs · Jest · Figma · Express.js · Highcharts · Git · Project Coordination · Product Requirements · Cross-browser Compatibility · Redux.js · TypeScript · Cross-functional Collaborations · Azure · Babel.js · Codebase Consolidation · Fluent UI · Responsive Web Design · JavaScript · Selenium · CI/CD implementation · Webpack · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Technical Leadership · Operational Excellence · Application Frameworks · Performance Improvement · System Architecture

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
o	Lead the goal of automating Azure deployment to all of it’s various clouds/regions via a full stack application.
o	Learned and ramped up on various technologies such as ASP.NET MVC 4, C#, React, and HTTP requests.
o	Effectively worked with authentication, UI, and backend teams to develop my multi discipline project to life.
positions.insights: Skills: REACT · Strategic Planning · REST APIs · ASP.NET · Product Requirements · JavaScript · C#

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Preformed PM and SWE roles under the Explorer program for the PowerApps and Common Data Service team 
- Pulled in Microsoft Dinning Api-s into CDS with Azure functions to create a Dinning PowerApp for employees  
- Utilized AngularJS, Typescript, and C# to implement and ship CDS portal feature enhancements
positions.insights: Skills: REACT · Strategic Planning · JavaScript · C# · AngularJS
